annotations.title: Lock a decision to the law of the day

description: Seals an AI decision or governance record together with the exact rules it was checked against, the laws in force that day and their official sources, and the result of every check, timestamped into Bitcoin. Years later it proves which law applied and how the decision measured up. Give 'record' (only its fingerprint is kept) or 'record_sha256', plus framework keys (default euaiact, gdpr, aiinsurance, aidamages, ukevidence). Returns the Law Lock page, fact and Court Pack.
name: sebbi_law_lock
